formats.key: claim(address _rewardOwner, address _recipient, uint24 _rewardEpochId, bool _wrap, (bytes32[] merkleProof, (uint24 rewardEpochId, bytes20 beneficiary, uint120 amount, uint8 claimType) body)[] _proofs)
effects: Claims the reward owner's Direct and Provider-fee rewards from each proof whose beneficiary equals _rewardOwner, using the proof amount capped at what the epoch still holds.
For Provider-fee proofs, a burn share set by flareSystemsCalculator.calculateBurnFactorPPM is sent to 0x...dEaD and the recipient gets the rest.
Delegation, mirrored-stake and C-chain proofs only initialise the provider's or node's reward pool; they pay nothing directly.

Claims all of the owner's weight-based rewards (WFLR delegation, P-chain mirror, C-chain stake) for every epoch from the next claimable one up to _rewardEpochId; the amount is computed on chain from vote power.
Marks the owner's epochs up to _rewardEpochId as claimed (rewardOwnerNextClaimableEpochId = _rewardEpochId + 1).
Sends the total to _recipient as native FLR, or as WFLR through wNat.depositTo when _wrap is true.
When the signer is not the owner, ClaimSetupManager checks that the signer is the owner's executor and that the recipient is allowed.
formats.shown: Claim rewards to the recipient, with the owner, recipient, last epoch, FLR or WFLR, and each proof's beneficiary, amount and claim type.

findings.title: claim: 'Proof amount' and 'Proof beneficiary' read as the signer's payout, but for pool claims they are not.
findings.evidence: RewardManager.sol _processProofs: types other than DIRECT/FEE only call _initialiseWeightBasedClaim, which stores the pool for address(rewardClaim.beneficiary) (the delegate or node); the payout comes from _claimWeightBasedRewards via _calculateRewardAmount. Descriptor labels 'Proof beneficiary' and 'Proof amount' are shown next to 'Reward Owner'.
findings.fix: Rename them to 'Reward pool owner' and 'Pool / claim amount', or add a message that delegation and stake proofs only initialise the provider's pool.

findings.title: claim: a Provider-fee proof can be partly burned, so the recipient may get less than 'Proof amount'.
findings.evidence: RewardManager.sol _claimFromDirectOrFeeClaim: if claimType == FEE and burnFactor > 0, _burnAmountWei = min(amount*burnFactor/PPM_MAX, amount); _rewardAmountWei -= _burnAmountWei; _claim: BURN_ADDRESS.transfer(burnAmountWei). The descriptor shows 'Proof amount' as the full leaf amount.
findings.fix: Label the field 'Gross reward (provider fees may be partly burned)'.

findings.title: claim: the proof beneficiary, amount and claim type are separate parallel lists the signer cannot pair.
findings.evidence: Descriptor fields '#._proofs.[].body.beneficiary.[-20:]', '#._proofs.[].body.amount', '#._proofs.[].body.claimType' are each a separate array path.
findings.fix: Group them per proof under one field on '#._proofs.[]' with the body fields inside.

findings.title: claim: 'Stake rewards up to epoch' omits delegation rewards and hides that all earlier epochs are claimed too.
findings.evidence: RewardManager.sol _claimWeightBasedRewards loops from _nextClaimableEpochId to _rewardEpochId over WNAT, MIRROR and CCHAIN rewards, then sets rewardOwnerNextClaimableEpochId. Descriptor label: 'Stake rewards up to epoch'.
findings.fix: Rename it to 'Claim all rewards up to epoch'.

findings.title: claim: the weight-based reward amount is computed from on-chain vote power and is not in the calldata.
findings.evidence: RewardManager.sol _claimRewards -> _calculateRewardAmount(state, _rewardWeight), where the weight comes from wNat.balanceOfAt, pChainStakeMirror.stakesOfAt and cChainStake.stakesOfAt.

findings.title: claim: the intent does not say whether FLR or WFLR arrives.
findings.evidence: interpolatedIntent 'Claim rewards to {_recipient}'; _transferOrWrap uses wNat.depositTo when _wrap is true. 'Receive as' is shown as a field.

formats.key: claimProxy(address _msgSender, address _rewardOwner, address _recipient, uint24 _rewardEpochId, bool _wrap, (bytes32[] merkleProof, (uint24 rewardEpochId, bytes20 beneficiary, uint120 amount, uint8 claimType) body)[] _proofs)
effects: Reverts unless msg.sender is ftsoRewardManagerProxy, so an EOA can never execute it directly.
When called by the proxy, it does the same as claim: pays the owner's Direct and Fee rewards minus any burn, plus all weight-based rewards up to _rewardEpochId, to _recipient as FLR or WFLR.
Checks the executor and recipient permissions for _msgSender instead of msg.sender.
formats.shown: Claim rewards to the recipient, with caller, owner, recipient, last epoch, FLR or WFLR, and the proof details.

findings.title: claimProxy: only the FtsoRewardManager proxy can call it, so a signer calling it directly always reverts.
findings.evidence: RewardManager.sol claimProxy: require(msg.sender == ftsoRewardManagerProxy, "only ftso reward manager proxy").
findings.fix: Say in the intent that this is called through the legacy FtsoRewardManager, or drop the format.

findings.title: claimProxy: 'Proof amount' and 'Proof beneficiary' read as the payout, but for pool claims they are not.
findings.evidence: _processProofs only initialises WNAT/MIRROR/CCHAIN pools for the delegate or node; the descriptor shows 'Proof amount' and 'Proof beneficiary'.
findings.fix: Rename them as in claim, and group the proof fields per proof.

findings.title: claimProxy: a Provider-fee proof can be partly burned, so the recipient may get less than 'Proof amount'.
findings.fix: Label it 'Gross reward (provider fees may be partly burned)'.

findings.title: claimProxy: the proof fields are separate parallel lists the signer cannot pair.

formats.key: autoClaim(address[] _rewardOwners, uint24 _rewardEpochId, (bytes32[] merkleProof, (uint24 rewardEpochId, bytes20 beneficiary, uint120 amount, uint8 claimType) body)[] _proofs)
effects: Initialises the weight-based reward pools in the proofs; Direct and Fee proofs are skipped because the owner is passed as address(0).
For each reward owner, claims weight-based rewards up to _rewardEpochId, plus the WNAT rewards of the owner's claim address (PDA), and marks those epochs claimed.
Deducts the executor fee from each owner's reward and deposits the rest as WFLR to the owner's claim address set in ClaimSetupManager, not necessarily the owner.
Pays the signer (executor) executorFeeValue times the number of owners, in native FLR.
Reverts if any owner's reward is below the executor fee.
formats.shown: Auto-claim and wrap rewards for the listed owners, with the last epoch and the proof details.

findings.title: autoClaim: the executor fee paid in FLR to the signer is not mentioned anywhere on the screen.
findings.evidence: RewardManager.sol autoClaim: rewardAmount -= executorFeeValue; ... _transferOrWrap(msg.sender, executorFeeValue * _rewardOwners.length, false). The intent 'Auto-claim and wrap rewards for {_rewardOwners.[]}' says nothing about a fee.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Auto-claim rewards for {_rewardOwners.[]} as WFLR and collect the executor fee in FLR'. The fee amount comes from storage.

findings.title: autoClaim: rewards go to each owner's claim address from ClaimSetupManager, not necessarily the listed owner.
findings.fix: None possible beyond wording, e.g. 'to their claim addresses'.

findings.title: autoClaim: 'Proof amount' implies a payout, but proofs only initialise pools and Direct/Fee proofs are ignored.
findings.evidence: autoClaim calls _processProofs(address(0), address(0), _proofs, ...), so the DIRECT/FEE branch is skipped (`if (_rewardOwner != address(0))`) and the other types are only initialised.
findings.fix: Rename it 'Pool amount (initialisation only)' and group the proof fields per proof.

findings.title: autoClaim: 'Stake rewards up to epoch' omits delegation rewards and that earlier epochs are claimed too.
findings.evidence: _claimWeightBasedRewards loops from the next claimable epoch to _rewardEpochId over WNAT, MIRROR and CCHAIN.
findings.fix: Use 'Claim all rewards up to epoch'.

formats.key: initialiseWeightBasedClaims((bytes32[] merkleProof, (uint24 rewardEpochId, bytes20 beneficiary, uint120 amount, uint8 claimType) body)[] _proofs)
effects: Verifies each weight-based proof against the epoch's Merkle root and records the beneficiary's reward pool amount and weight; no funds move.
Direct and Fee proofs are skipped; any caller may do this for any beneficiary.
formats.shown: Initialise claims for the proof beneficiaries, with each proof's amount and claim type.

findings.title: initialiseWeightBasedClaims: 'Proof amount' with an EOA-only beneficiary suggests a payment, but nothing moves.
findings.evidence: RewardManager.sol _initialiseWeightBasedClaim only sets state.initialised, state.amount and state.weight; the descriptor's Beneficiary field has types ['eoa'] while for MIRROR the beneficiary is a node id.
findings.fix: Rename it 'Pool amount (no transfer)' and widen the types or relabel 'Provider / node'.

findings.title: initialiseWeightBasedClaims: the proof fields are parallel lists and the proof epoch is hidden.
findings.fix: Group them per proof on '#._proofs.[]' and show the epoch.
